prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System:Regional Flow Platform=Cedarbell;Meridian International Airport/Harbor East Airport/North Valley Airport/Lakeside Regional Airport/Southport Airport retain authority. Aliases:Airline Operations Coordinator=Saffron;Regional Flow Manager=Copperfin;Demand Prediction Service=Marlinstone;Weather Ingest Gateway=Orchard;Airport CDM Portal=Foxglove;Tower Supervisor=Brindle;Ramp Control Lead=Quartzline;Slot Allocation Engine=Blueharbor;Slot Coordinator=Halcyon;Tower Sequence Manager=Ironleaf;Ramp Movement Board=Skylark;Alert Distribution Hub=Lantern;Departure Metering Service=Emberline;Arrival Regulation Console=Nightjar(help-only). Airline Operations Centre→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange:Flight Intent Message;Identity Access Service authenticates;invalid/incomplete rejected(reason-codes);material intents supersede schedules;changes require messages;Marlinstone forecasts. Cedarbell normalizes Airport Capacity Plan;Capacity Assessment Module updates Airport Acceptance Rate/runway/taxiway/sector constraints. Blueharbor→Adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time/Target Off Block Time/arrival-opportunities;freeze:Pushback Window Token. Capacity>preferences;safety/emergency/humanitarian/national-obligation>commercial>discretionary;fairness mandatory. Halcyon confirms publication/compliance;Saffron pre-freeze;Aircraft Operator Representative readiness;changes justified. Foxglove read-only except coordination-roles;stands cannot override airspace. Orchard validates weather/provenance/overrides;Storm Cell Snapshot confidence/degradation/provisional-capacity visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer verifies/updates ceiling/visibility/wind/convection. East Apron Sensor/West Apron Sensor→Skylark→Surface Surveillance Adapter→Foxglove:movements/milestones(≤5s/validated-event);Adapter verifies reopening→Skylark/Ironleaf:occupancy/equipment-status. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form;Brindle/Airport Duty Manager resolve conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter receive capacities;Brindle advised-only. Recovery Phase/Contingency Fallback State:safe diversion acceptance/prioritization/communication/recovery. Lantern→groups:role-specific timing/constraints/decision-ownership. Digital Briefing Room→Collaborative Decision

New part:
S521: The Airline Operations Coordinator confirms whether the aircraft can remain on plan, accept a short readiness deferral, or require a revised departure intent.
S522: The Handling Resource Planner assigns a severity level to the handler exception and suppresses duplicate updates while the accountable party is still working the same recovery action.
S523: The Ground Handling Dispatcher sends the Towbar Shortage Report when towbar availability cannot support the agreed pushback sequence.
S524: Towbar availability is escalated only when the missing equipment affects a flight inside the active departure planning horizon or blocks a higher-priority aircraft movement.
S525: The Ramp Movement Board displays the resulting constraint as a stand-level exception with a time band rather than as a continuous stream of equipment messages.
S526: Handler exceptions include staffing gaps, equipment unserviceability, access limitations, and service sequencing conflicts that could invalidate a readiness milestone.
S527: The Airport CDM Portal keeps detailed handler notes available to authorized users while the Common Situation Display shows only the flight impact, severity, and expected recovery window.
S528: This separation prevents local troubleshooting details from crowding the regional view used by the Regional Flow Manager, Tower Supervisor, and Slot Coordinator.
S529: The Alert Distribution Hub routes notifications according to severity, time to milestone, and subscribed operational role, rather than broadcasting every exception to all users.
S530: A baggage or handler exception becomes a coordination issue when it threatens the Target Off Block Time, the Calculated Takeoff Time, or an agreed runway metering sequence.
S531: At that point, the Airport CDM Portal prompts the accountable role to record the proposed mitigation in the Collaborative Decision Log.
S532: The Regional Flow Manager sees aggregated impact by departure bank, runway stream, and airline group instead of individual baggage or handler work items.
S533: The Slot Allocation Engine uses the sanitized readiness state when evaluating whether a regulated flight can keep its allocated departure opportunity.
S534: The Departure Metering Service applies exception status only after the Business Rules Registry threshold confirms that the condition is operationally material.
S535: Nightjar shall suppress handler-exception annotations for arriving flights unless the exception changes the Airport Acceptance Rate or a regulated arrival sequence.
S536: The Tower Sequence Manager receives a stable readiness indicator and an escalation flag, which allows tower planning to continue without interpreting ramp work details.
S537: The Audit Event Ledger records who raised, changed, acknowledged, or closed each escalated exception so that later review can distinguish data noise from operational decisions.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
